hero.subtitulo: Discover the unique experience at our boutique hotel.

about_us.parrafo1: Villa Vicuña Boutique Hotel Cafayate was born from a family dream, as a cozy place to rest and enjoy the dunes, vineyards, bike rides, and unforgettable serenades.
about_us.parrafo2: Through corridors, stairs, and vineyards unfold the 12 rooms surrounding the cobblestone patios, where starry nights become idyllic by the bonfire.
about_us.parrafo3: A few meters from the Cafayate Cathedral stands Boutique Villa Vicuña with the typical Salteño colonial style, where polished wood and exquisite details make your stay perfect.

desayuno.texto:
In our buffet you will find homemade delights for all tastes, because we understand the importance of a complete, healthy breakfast made with fresh, home-made products.

We offer our menus that can be consulted whenever you wish to enjoy our flavors during your stay.
reseñas: “We really enjoyed the breakfast; the buffet is extremely varied and complete. The best... ‘poached eggs’!”
“What a pleasant morning having breakfast in the cobblestone patio; the coffee is exquisite and not to mention the pastries, we leave happy after trying ‘Argentine mate’.”
“The buffet is a delight, from English tableware to homemade sweets and the variety of cakes; as I always say, I will return to have breakfast at Villa Vicuña.”

detalles.texto: Because they envelop us, disconnect us, and transport us to other times, at Villa Vicuña we pay special attention to details, creating corners for unforgettable moments.
reseñas: “The hotel's location is unbeatable, the colonial decoration, the English touches, and the Cuzco art... a true delight.”
“Wonderful hotel, my children feel like they are in the movie ‘Encanto’, the stairs, the balconies, the beds in the suite, the best memory of Cafayate.”
“We had a comfortable stay, we were able to disconnect and relax, our rooms are true luxury, the highlight were the nights by the bonfire tasting Cafayate wines.”

personal.texto: Our team... our family, responsible for the outstanding warmth and quality of our services, whose dedication and friendliness make our guests feel at home.
reseñas: “This is my third visit to Villa Vicuña, this time I came with friends, I am very grateful for the cordiality with which they received me and the attention that all the staff is accustomed to.”
“Everything was very pleasant, we highlight the effort of the staff in general, for making our stay enjoyable by taking care of every detail.”
“Thank you very much for the dedicated attention, from the first moment we felt at home, if we return to Cafayate without a doubt we will stay at Villa Vicuña.”

reseñas.descripcion: At Villa Vicuña our guests are the main driving force behind our constant work to achieve excellence in quality and services; their reviews are what we treasure as a source of inspiration.

menu.descripcion: Discover the exclusive flavors of Villa Vicuña. A unique combination of local ingredients and traditional recipes.

twin.descripcion:
Facing the cobblestone patio, along the corridors surrounded by vineyards, our Twins feature two comfortable beds in the room, protected by the characteristic shutters that distinguish our hotel.
You can request with or without stairs access.
twin.parrafo_minibar: Among the amenities you will find a complimentary minibar where you can serve yourself a drink while you relax.

triple.descripcion: Facing the cobblestone patio, along the corridors surrounded by vineyards, our Triple rooms accommodate three guests; one double bed and one single share the space, protected by our signature shutters.
